result.summary: The page is largely well-composed (header, search, chips, promo banner, carousels and list cards all render cleanly). The main visual defect is at the bottom: the fixed tab bar sits flush against the screen edge with no safe-area inset, so the iOS home indicator bar draws directly across the Search and Orders icons and the icons themselves are clipped. Two smaller polish issues: the tab bar has no text labels, and the favorite (heart) button is styled inconsistently between the two restaurant cards.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar ignores the device safe-area inset: the black home-indicator pill overlaps the Search and Orders icons, and the icons are cropped by the bottom screen edge, making the bar look broken and the tabs hard to tap.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area padding (e.g. env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) to the tab bar container, increase its height so icons sit fully above the home indicator, and vertically center the icons within the padded bar.

issues.description: Bottom tab bar items show only icons with no text labels, and only the Home icon is colored/active-styled, leaving the other destinations ambiguous.
issues.suggestion: Add short labels (Home, Search, Orders, Account) under each icon and ensure consistent active/inactive icon styling and adequate touch target size.

issues.description: The favorite/heart control is inconsistent between list cards: on the pizza card it sits on a dark translucent circular background, while on the ramen card it is a bare white outline with no backing, reducing contrast against the lighter image area.
issues.suggestion: Use one shared favorite-button component with the same circular scrim/background and size on all restaurant cards so it stays legible over any image.
